filter.health_condition: Twins aged 60+ with previously reported low dietary protein intake

projects.intervention_detail: Daily sachet for 12 weeks: BCAA protein powder (l-leucine, l-isoleucine, l-valine) for all; intervention arm additionally received prebiotic (inulin + FOS, Darmocare Pre), placebo arm received maltodextrin; resistance exercise advised to all twice weekly
